title: chore(ui): retire the zero-consumer root and config orphans (paseo, typedoc, lazy-test, console dead devDeps)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVH2LGNgHQKK59V3MVareD5)_

Part of #25921

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：删掉 `ui/` 下三个没人用的根配置文件（`paseo.json`、`typedoc.json`、`lazy-test.mjs`），连带 `typedoc` / `typedoc-plugin-markdown` 两个 devDep、`docs:api` 脚本和 lint 覆盖账本里 `lazy-test.mjs` 那一行；再删 console 的四个死 devDep（`@dnd-kit/core|sortable|utilities`、`autoprefixer`），lockfile 随之重生成（纯删 256 行）。
- **为什么改**：卡 #25921 的「根与配置孤儿」项；每项在 `origin/main` 上重测都是零消费者，留着只会误导（`paseo.json` 还在教 `pnpm i`，违背 frozen-lockfile 规则）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。不改任何源码、不改发布产物；console 的 `vendor-dndkit` 分块照常产出（dnd-kit 经 app-shell 等包传入）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/package.json`（删的四个 devDep）、`ui/scripts/check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs`（删一行豁免）、`pnpm-lock.yaml`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && git grep -n -E "typedoc|paseo|lazy-test" -- ui` —— 安装成功，grep 零命中。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Deleted `ui/paseo.json`, `ui/typedoc.json`, `ui/lazy-test.mjs`.
- `ui/package.json`: dropped the `docs:api` script and the `typedoc` and `typedoc-plugin-markdown` devDependencies. `typedoc-plugin-markdown` is named only by `typedoc.json`'s `plugin` list, so it goes with the typedoc item.
- `ui/scripts/check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs`: dropped the `lazy-test.mjs` row from the vacuous-group list (its only reference).
- `ui/apps/console/package.json`: dropped the `@dnd-kit/core`, `@dnd-kit/sortable`, `@dnd-kit/utilities` and `autoprefixer` devDependencies.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated with `pnpm install`; the diff is deletions only (the two importers' entries plus typedoc's private closure: typedoc, typedoc-plugin-markdown, `@gerrit0/mini-shiki`, four `@shikijs/*`, lunr, markdown-it, linkify-it, mdurl, punycode.js, uc.micro, entities 4).

## Why

Zero-consumer measurement on `origin/main` `69ce01d7` (the claim's base), `git grep` over the whole tree, lockfile and CHANGELOGs excluded:

| Item | Hits outside itself | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paseo.json` | 1, a hypothetical example in a comment in `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` (not a reader) | dead |
| `typedoc` / `typedoc.json` / `docs:api` | only `ui/package.json` itself, plus a historical comment in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (see Acceptance notes) | dead |
| `lazy-test.mjs` | only the exemption row in `check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs` | dead |
| console `autoprefixer` | 0 in `ui/apps/console`; its `postcss.config.js` loads only `@tailwindcss/postcss` | dead |
| console `@dnd-kit/*` | 0 imports in console source, tests or config | dead as a console declaration |

Positive control for the same grep: `@dnd-kit` hits 45 files on `origin/main`, 39 of them under `ui/packages/` (app-shell 11, plugin-kanban 17, layout 3, plugin-dashboard 3, plugin-view 3, components 1, react 1). `app-shell`, `layout`, `plugin-kanban` and `plugin-dashboard` each declare all three `@dnd-kit` packages themselves.

**Kept: the `vendor-dndkit` entry in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`.** It is a real consumer of the bundle, not of the console's declaration: `@dnd-kit` still reaches the console build through the workspace packages above. Measured: the console build on this branch still emits `assets/vendor-dndkit-*.js`. So `vite.config.ts` is not touched.

**Excluded, left on the card:** the two playwright import-harness configs (the docs/qa checklist's knownGaps names them), the providers/upload fold, the two remaining reset helpers (`resetActionKeyWarnings` sits behind open PR #28188), the msw text in `skills/**` (governed), i18n keys, and the per-package barrel batches.

**No changeset (`skip-changeset`):** nothing a released package ships changes. `ui/package.json` is the private workspace root. `@object-ui/console` only loses devDependencies, which an installer never reads, and its built `dist/` keeps the same `@dnd-kit` resolution through `app-shell`.

## Acceptance notes

- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` keeps the override `'markdown-it@>=14.0.0 <14.3.3': '^14.3.3'` and its comment ("pulled 14.3.0 through typedoc and @vscode/vsce"). After this PR `markdown-it` is gone from the lockfile entirely, so the override matches nothing. That file is outside this claim's surface, so it is left as it is: dropping the override and its comment is a one-line follow-up for the seat to route. `check:override-consistency` exits 0 on this head.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-u9x8uu` is the platform-assigned card-thread branch (the claim records it), not `claude/issue-N-slug`.

## Verification

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 36 commands on `8fe61662`; all 36 ran, and `--ran` reports `36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. On the first pass, three were prerequisite readings, not verdicts on the diff: `vitest run scripts/` exit 1 (two suites could not resolve unbuilt `@objectstack/client` / `@objectstack/spec`), `check:dts-closure` exit 1 (missing `.d.ts`), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3. After building (console closure 71/71, `./packages/**` 76/76), all three exit 0. `vitest run scripts/` then gave 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4901 tests passed. After merging `origin/main` (4 commits, none touching these files), the re-derived list is identical.
- Also run: `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `eslint scripts/check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs` (in `ui/`) exit 0; `node scripts/check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exit 0 on the regenerated lockfile.
- Console build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console...` 71/71, `os-verify-lock` VERDICT command-exit 0; `ui/apps/console/dist/assets/vendor-dndkit-*.js` emitted.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against every open PR: clean (exit 0) for all 19. Only the mailbox PRs #27357, #27309 and #27523 and the Version Packages PR #26517 touch any of these files, and each merges clean.
- No ablation: nothing here changes a behaviour that a test pins (configs and manifests only).
